notes: Focused Java public-API evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2. The scenario creates each of the 25 standard basic data-element interfaces through EncoderFactory, encodes each of two values with toByteArray(), decodes into a fresh helper with DataElement.decode(byte[]), and checks the decoded value. It verifies Java basic-data-element round trips; it does not claim exact wire representations, exhaustive Annex C behavior, independent-provider behavior, or conformance.
